_about: Puzzles extracted from the Escolha Sorteada probability tables. The player holds the initiative (plays blue) and must name the symbol and pick the destination. value/secondValue are P(blue wins) for the best and second-best move; margin is the difference. Every puzzle is cross-checked against BOTH converged bounds: lo and hi must agree on the best move and on the second-best symbol, and their margins must agree within 0.02; the published numbers are the midpoint. This matters because lo and hi do not meet - the gap between them is the board structural draw mass, not iteration error. NOTE: value, secondValue and margin are rounded independently from the solver doubles, so value-secondValue differs from margin by up to 1e-4 - use margin, do not recompute. pass=true means the move is to name a piece with no legal move, passing on purpose to force the opponent to move that symbol; to is null in that case, never -1. question=piece when the two best moves belong to different symbols (the puzzle is which piece to name), destination when they share a symbol. tier comes from absolute margin bands: sharp 0.05-0.10, subtle 0.10-0.20, clear above 0.20.
